integrity: A causal all-size proof and a nine-case exact counting argument are provided. Two self-contained computational checks corroborate finite cases; neither is represented as an infinite proof or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous three-state two-neighbor excitation on labelled quadrilateral books B_m with m>=1. General induced-density arguments already imply eventual extinction, so novelty is limited to the sharp size-independent clock, exact first-hitting census, and asymptotic temporal law. Unindexed literature may contain equivalents; no external independent audit.
title: A sharp three-update extinction clock and exact first-hitting census for two-contact excitation on quadrilateral books
